# Smart Home With Me — Librus Synergia Native Dashboard
# Compatible with Librus Synergia — Smart Home With Me v1.6.1
#
# 100% native Home Assistant cards:
# - vertical-stack
# - horizontal-stack
# - entities
# - section / attribute rows
#
# No Mushroom, card-mod or other custom cards required.
#
# SETUP
# 1. Create a new dashboard view and set View type to Panel (1 card).
# 2. Add a Manual card and paste this entire YAML.
# 3. Replace `your_child` in the entity IDs with the slug generated by
#    Home Assistant for your student, for example:
#
#       librus_your_child  -> librus_john_smith
#       librus_synergia_your_child -> librus_synergia_john_smith
#
# 4. Entity IDs can differ depending on your existing entity registry.
#    Check Settings -> Devices & services -> Librus Synergia -> your student.
# 5. Subject-specific sensors are optional. Remove any rows that do not
#    exist in your installation, or replace them with your own subjects.
#
# IMPORTANT
# This file contains no real student name or private school data.


type: vertical-stack

cards:

  # ===================================================================
  # ROW 1 — STUDENT + LIBRUS SUMMARY

    cards:
